lactater: Tools for Analyzing Lactate Thresholds

Source: R/lactater-package.R
lactater-package.Rd

Set of tools for analyzing lactate thresholds from a step incremental test to exhaustion. Estimate Log-log, Onset of Blood Lactate Accumulation (OBLA), Baseline plus (Bsln+), the Dmax family, Lactate Turn Points (LTP), the Lactate / Intensity ratio (LTratio), and the Individual Anaerobic Thresholds of Dickhuth (IAT) and Stegmann in cycling, running, swimming, or rowing, with bootstrap confidence intervals, data-quality checks, training zones, test comparisons, training load, and the maximal lactate accumulation rate (VLamax).
